downstream_uses.thm-sr-proper-orthochronous-lorentz-alge: [L4] For every unit spatial vector $e$ and all $\beta_1,\beta_2\in(-1,1)$, $B(\beta_1e)B(\beta_2e)=B\bigl(\frac{\beta_1+\beta_2}{1+\beta_1\beta_2}e\bigr)$ with $\bigl|\frac{\beta_1+\beta_2}{1+\beta_1\beta_2}\bigr|<1$, and the two collinear boosts commute ([[lem-collinear-boost-composition-and-velocity-addition]]).
